# Swap WETH

> Swap WETH is an informational interface for trading WETH (Wrapped Ether) on Ethereum and EVM chains. WETH is an ERC-20 token that equals one ETH 1:1; wrapping ETH mints WETH so it can be traded in DEX pools and used by smart contracts. Non-custodial: you sign every transaction from your own wallet.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- WETH = Wrapped Ether, an ERC-20 token pegged 1:1 to native ETH. ETH predates ERC-20 and is not itself an ERC-20 token, so WETH exists to meet that interface.
- Wrap vs swap: ETH <-> WETH is a wrap/unwrap at a fixed 1:1 rate with no slippage, only gas. WETH <-> another token is a market swap routed through a DEX, with a quote, price impact and slippage.
- Swapping WETH: a DEX or aggregator finds the best route and quote; you approve WETH once (ERC-20 allowance), then sign the swap, which settles on-chain.
- Costs: network gas paid in native ETH for each step (wrap, approve, swap) + pool/aggregator fee reflected in the quote. Wrapping has no trading fee. Keep ETH for gas even if you hold WETH.
- Security: non-custodial; verify token contracts (fake WETH and lookalike stablecoins are common), practice approval hygiene; smart-contract risk remains.
